title: Buried Pellet Test Protocol
author: Ana Catarina Carapinha Cascalho

steps.title: Food deprivation & cage labeling
steps.instruction: Deprive 8‑week‑old mice of food for 20 h before the test while keeping the water bottle in the cage (ad libitum). Place a “Special protocol – No Food” sticker on the cage lid so caretakers do not add food.

steps.title: Room habituation
steps.instruction: On the test day, habituate each mouse for 30 min by moving its home cage to the testing room; remove the water bottle, feeder bin, and metal grid, and use only a filter‑top lid.

steps.title: Prepare test cages
steps.instruction: During habituation, set up one clean cage per mouse with 3 cm deep clean bedding (evenly distributed). Bury a food pellet at the bottom in a corner so it is not visible. Draw a map indicating the pellet location and position the map within the camera view for the entire test.

steps.title: Arrange cages for recording
steps.instruction: Place two prepared cages (each with 3 cm bedding and a hidden pellet) inside the camera frame. Surround the cages with paper barriers so the mice cannot see each other or escape. Keep the pellet‑location map visible throughout the recording.

steps.title: Introduce mouse & start timer
steps.instruction: Put the testing mouse into its cage opposite the hidden pellet corner (if testing two mice simultaneously, each goes into its own cage). Start the timer immediately.

steps.title: Measure latency to uncover
steps.instruction: Stop the timer when the mouse uncovers the pellet and begins eating (time counted until the mouse touches the pellet). If the mouse does not find the pellet within 5 min, end the trial and record a latency of 300 s.

steps.title: Return mouse to new cage
steps.instruction: After the trial, move the mouse to a fresh cage with ad libitum food and water. Do not return it to the home cage if other mice remain untested.

steps.title: Repeat for each mouse
steps.instruction: Repeat steps 3–7 for each mouse, burying the pellet in a different spot for each trial. Allow one regular day of ad libitum food and water between trials.
